title: Reading Multiple Regression from an Ellipsoid Inscribed in the Unit Hypercube
summary: Consider the linear regression of a response $Y$ on explanatory variables $X_1,\dots,X_p$ with a positive definite joint correlation matrix. Let $\mathbf{R}$ be the correlation matrix of the explanatory variables and $\mathbf{r}$ the vector of their correlations with $Y$. The ellipsoid $E=\{\mathbf{x} : \mathbf{x}^{\top}\mathbf{R}^{-1}\mathbf{x}=1\}$ is inscribed in the cube $[-1,1]^p$ and touches the face $x_j=1$ at $T_j$, the $j$th column of $\mathbf{R}$. The point $P=\mathbf{r}$ lies inside $E$, and three kinds of regression quantities are read off this diagram by elementary geometric…
